question: Which complete downstream head and MLP responses causally transmit the two canonical temporal/is-was modes produced by the sealed conditional writer frontier?
population: Reuse the 28 already-opened, discovery-disjoint v11 frontier rows. No new row selection or fitting occurs.
source_intervention: Replay the validated mask-30 donor response program (L7H8 + L9H1/H4 + MLP7 + MLP9) into each base example. For every attention head and MLP in layers 12-17, replace that site's complete live causal-prefix response with its native base response and allow all later computation to recompute.

predictions.instrument: Authorities, exact 60-site inventory, native replay, base self-clamp, attention reconstruction, canonical reader hash, finiteness, parent mask-30 behavioral replay, and 71-forward/1988-example price close.
predictions.known_readers: At least one of L15H5 or L15H1 has positive signed final-state necessity with magnitude at least 0.05 in both tasks for at least one canonical mode.
predictions.weight_enrichment: For at least one canonical mode, static downstream weight score has Spearman correlation at least 0.20 with pooled absolute causal necessity and the layer-matched highest-weight head exceeds the lowest-weight head in at least four of six layers.
predictions.novel_l17h4: Weight-ranked L17H4 has positive signed necessity at least 0.03 with cosine at least 0.40 for at least one task-mode cell.
predictions.complete_atlas: All 60 frozen sites have finite two-task/two-mode final-state and behavioral necessity measurements, with zero fitting, updates, or backwards passes.

decision: A pass validates the tensor contraction as a causal downstream candidate generator and promotes L17H4 if its frozen cell passes. Failure of weight enrichment retains the atlas as causal evidence but demotes raw weights to incidence only; failure of the positive control invalidates the intervention/readout interpretation. No greedy union is licensed until this singleton necessity atlas is complete.
